name: Anan (Nagano, Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Anan town emblem in white: a disc with a pointed fly bearing a navy stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Anan, a town in Nagano Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 22 July 1971.

features.role: Anan town emblem — a disc with a pointed fly bearing a navy stylised character
